findings: Non-blocking (confirmed): SCRM auto-capture hook in navigate_to moved from AFTER reconstruct_context to BEFORE it, so auto-capture now snaps the DEPARTING context rather than the arrived one. The move is forced by the refactor (the old post-reconstruct capture relied on a stale flat menu_workspace field that cannot survive once the state lives inside TabKind). The only covering test (auto_capture_records_on_navigation, POM->FILES) passes under both orderings; the behavioural difference only surfaces in untested menu->menu and panel->menu transitions. The replaced behaviour was itself accidental and inconsistent, and the coder documented the change in the code comment and the resume note. Flag for owner awareness; a follow-up test could pin the intended auto-capture content if it matters for SCRM evidence flows.
